# Plain — Plain for Startups

50% off Plain's Horizon plan: a $6k flat fee covering 12 months and 10 seats, for VC-backed startups with up to $5m in funding that are not already Plain customers.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but requires a sales conversation |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [💬 Customer Support](../categories/support.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | discount |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **When it ends** | Once your discount wraps up, hop on any plan that fits your new stage — whether it's Foundation, Horizon or Frontier. |


### Not covered

- Existing Plain customers
- Support teams larger than 10

> **Stacking:** If and when you need more than 10 seats throughout the duration of the 12 month plan, extra seats will be charged at our annual Expansion tier price. Plain states the program cannot be made cheaper for fewer than 10 seats.
